data.content_ref: inline:The target admits its own reading is speculative and internally inconsistent: it hypothesizes roman front matter i, ii using 2+2=4 characters, then subtracts 6 from 792 to get 786. The subtraction of 6 is unsupported even under the speculative reading, since i, ii yield 4 roman numeral characters, not 6 digits. Its own counterconditions concede that if roman characters are not 'digits' the branch collapses. Thus the claimed 298 pages rests on an arithmetically ungrounded and self-refuting assumption.
